$schema_note: Hand-authored roster data for the Side Quest MVP town. Field-for-field mirror of the finalized NPC schema in docs/design-doc.md §7 (also scaffolded in Assets/Scripts/Data/NPC.cs). No PlayerCharacter here — the player is defined elsewhere. See README.md in this folder for conventions.
$notes: Tension web: Rival pairs = Rosa<->Dante (unpaid seed money) and Lenny<->Vik (noise feud). Family pairs = Maribel<->Dante (aunt/nephew), Maribel<->Ruby (mother/daughter), Priya<->Rosa (cousins), Frank<->Iris (brother/sister), Petra<->Vik (grandmother/grandson). Romantic pair = Ana<->Jin (mutual); Ruby's one-sided interest in Vik is deliberate narrative asymmetry, not a Romantic label.

Section 22 seed: Rosa (Shopkeeper) — Job.Performance 0.27 is already below the ~0.3 firing threshold with Diligence 0.25, so the deterministic trigger has something to fire on immediately. Errol is a diligence-collision character (0.2) but unemployed, so he is NOT a section-22 employed-trigger candidate.
Greta is the gossip-network hub: low honesty, high extroversion — her retellings of the Rosa-Dante fight differ by retelling, a human face for the section-9 distortion mechanic.
Conventions: location ids are the six section-20 MVP locations; item_* ids are forward-declared strings pending an item registry; schedule times are HH:MM local 24h; timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC.
